review: Scorecard: no finished round to grade yet. R12 starts Tuesday, but this report now targets R13, so its saved predictions grade R13. Last round, R11 (unofficial, our count), came to about 168 with your screenshot lineup: Vezenkov (C) 57, Faye 21, Feliz 19, and coach Penarroya (PAR) +20, while Madar 11, Joksimović 2 and Davidovac 8 held it back. Calls: selling Madar was right (broken nose, still doubtful), and Masiulis (ZAL) looks a sound R12 coach (Valančiūnas was R11 MVP, and Zalgiris are about 80% vs Bayern). Owned miss: until tonight my_team.json still showed 4 R12 trades left after you'd made them, so the 19:06 report was still planning R12. Fixed with trades_done_for_round: 12, and this run plans R13. Research: 27 searches, 5 pages read, 1 player unverified (Diop's domestic game).
window_plan: I'd make rebuild 1 with one change. Sell Nunn, Herrera, Davidovac, Joksimović and Diarra; buy Payne, Frisch, Procida, Valančiūnas and Llull, with coach Martinez (RMB). Valančiūnas is the clear upgrade at center, and Procida and Frisch are minutes-backed cheap enablers. I'd check Llull against Madrid's guard returns (Campazzo, Maledon) before the window, and keep Diop only until Onyema is registered. The R13 trades above already move Nunn → Payne, so the window needs fewer moves. Prices will shift after R12–R13, so I'll redo this on 21 Nov.
